Title: Task Tracking Feature V1 Implementation
Content: MemorySmith has a file-backed task domain at Data/Tasks with a site-level /tasks workbench and api/tasks endpoints for CRUD, status updates, comments, links, attachments, history, and soft/hard delete. Assignee handling is dictionary-first with Directory mode and optional Custom text mode. Linked page checks are warning-only: missing pages do not block linking and produce page_link_warning activity entries. Runtime hardening now includes malformed-task fallback loading: parse-failing files are represented as HasLoadError records instead of crashing list operations, with LoadError and SourceFilePath metadata. Mutations on malformed fallback records are blocked by EnsureTaskIsEditable, but controller exception mapping is currently uneven across mutation endpoints and should be standardized to non-500 4xx contracts. Runtime probes also confirmed task read APIs can be reached without auth headers under current profile combinations, so explicit view-policy enforcement is now tracked as high-priority hardening. Priority triage now follows severity-first ordering: active exposure and availability risks before maintainability-only refactors.
